text: To enrich campus life and help international students make more friends, the Student Union is scheduled to host a Singing Contest at the University Hall from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on May 20.
The relevant details are as follows.
First, each participant is expected to sing one Chinese or English song, with professional teachers serving as judges.
Second, not only can this contest offer a stage to display your talent, but it also provides prizes for the top three winners.
Those interested should send an email to contest@university.edu.cn before May 15.
Your active participation will be warmly welcomed!
